definitions.explanation: A state free from disturbance, conflict, or anxiety. Describes a quiet, uneventful, and stable condition of life, society, or nature.

examples.japanese: {平穏|へいおん}な{日々|ひび}を{過|す}ごす。
{町|まち}に{平穏|へいおん}が{戻|もど}った。
{長年|ながねん}の{争|あらそ}いが{終|お}わり、{人々|ひとびと}はようやく{平穏|へいおん}な{暮|く}らしを{取|と}り{戻|もど}すことができた。
examples.english: After years of conflict ended, the people were finally able to reclaim a peaceful life.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or formal word. More elevated in register than {静|しず}か (quiet) or {穏|おだ}やか (calm). Often used in news reports and written descriptions of social conditions. {平穏|へいおん}な{生活|せいかつ} (peaceful life) and {平穏|へいおん}な{日々|ひび} (peaceful days) are very common phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平穏|へいおん}な{日々|ひび}: peaceful days
- {平穏|へいおん}な{生活|せいかつ}: peaceful life
- {平穏|へいおん}な{暮|く}らし: tranquil living
- {平穏|へいおん}を{保|たも}つ: to maintain peace
- {平穏|へいおん}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す: to restore peace
- {平穏|へいおん}{無事|ぶじ}: safe and peaceful
